plain_english_summary: Deterministic neural-signal encoding and retrieval system for bounded extracellular recording lanes.
commercial_wedge: For neurotech research-infrastructure teams needing deterministic, reproducible encoding of extracellular neural recordings with auditable proof lineage. Business value: reproducibility and auditability for neural signal pipelines.
technical_wedge: Deterministic 8-primitive encoding applied to extracellular neural signals, evidenced by DANDI 000034 validation and a counted IBL second-target PASS under bounded refinement.
ideal_first_buyer: Neurotech research-infrastructure team or academic neuroscience platform needing deterministic signal encoding with proof lineage.
deployment_model: Python package (pip install -e .), private staged. Not currently distributed as a public package.
proof_anchors: Proof corpus under proofs/ with manifest lineage
not_claimed: No broad neural generality — extracellular lane only
family_position: Validates ZPE encoding generality to neural signal domains. Staged/validation tier alongside Mocap, Prosody, and Bio.
